europe_now.title: US and Denmark agree on Greenland security pact
europe_now.summary: Denmark and the United States have concluded a new security arrangement involving military infrastructure in Greenland. The agreement addresses Arctic defense and regional strategic cooperation.

europe_now.title: EU sanctions policy updates spark debate
europe_now.summary: Recent adjustments to EU sanctions lists have drawn sharp reactions and criticism from regional partners. The developments highlight ongoing tensions regarding enforcement and diplomatic alignment.

top_stories.title: Energy Pressures and Price Relief
top_stories.summary: Rising energy costs have prompted governments across Europe to expand consumer relief measures. France has scaled up targeted fuel subsidies to protect households from market volatility.
